Name: Mirror of Broken Memories
Description: You see yourself. Not now, not then. A version that never existed—but almost did. The mirror grins before you do.
Effect: -2 Sanity, +1 Hope if you take Glass Memory

Name: The Whispering Wound
Description: The floor splits. Voices rise—not from below, but from inside.
Effect: Lose 1 Hope OR discard one item

Name: The Dead Library
Description: Books breathe. Paper bleeds. Someone has bookmarked your pain.
Effect: Gain Memory Tome, choose +2 Sanity or reveal 2 tiles

Name: The Crooked Bell
Description: It tolls once when you lie. It tolls again when you forget.
Effect: +1 Hope if you discard an item; else, -1 Sanity

Name: Shiverglass Lake
Description: The water reflects everything but the present.
Effect: Draw 2 items, pick 1

Name: The Nameless Grave
Description: The marker’s blank. But you feel grief anyway.
Effect: +1 Hope, -1 Sanity

Name: The Bleeding Window
Description: A crying thing peers out, mouthing your name in reverse.
Effect: -1 Sanity, gain Muted Stone

Name: The Laughing Statue
Description: Teeth that belong to no face. Eyes that blink after you leave.
Effect: Roll d6: (1–2) -2 Sanity, (3–4) nothing, (5–6) gain Bone Charm

Name: Hall of Familiar Eyes
Description: You recognize them all. Even the ones that never existed.
Effect: If both players present: +1 Hope each. Alone: -1 Hope

Name: The Hungering Gate
Description: A door with no hinges. Only hunger.
Effect: Lose 1 item or 2 Health

Name: The Candle That Would Not Die
Description: The flame burns memory instead of wax.
Effect: +1 Sanity, 50% chance to gain Eternal Candle

Name: Beneath the Clockface
Description: The second hand runs backwards. Your age peels off in layers.
Effect: Skip next turn, gain +1 Hope, +1 Health

Name: The Mouth in the Wall
Description: It doesn’t speak. It chews. And it’s chewing your name.
Effect: -1 Sanity, gain Echo Stone

Name: The Rusted Oracle
Description: Its prophecies cost teeth.
Effect: Lose 1 Health, gain a tile’s effect without entering

Name: The Siren’s Silence
Description: No sound. But your ears bleed trying to hear what isn’t there.
Effect: -1 Sanity, +1 Hope

Name: The Loom of Regret
Description: Threads stretch from your fingers to others long dead.
Effect: Trade 1 item with Cait (even if not on same tile)

Name: The Cracked Throne
Description: Once sat upon by something that still watches.
Effect: Gain Crown of Loss (+1 Hope, -1 Sanity)

Name: Forgotten Orchard
Description: Fruit rots on the branch. It smells like your childhood bedroom.
Effect: Gain Withered Apple (+1 Health)

Name: The Well of Names
Description: It calls out your name. Then hers. Then names you didn’t know mattered.
Effect: Gain Paper Tongue (lets you speak to one tile ahead)

Name: The Puppeteer’s Nest
Description: Strings twitch. Fingers snap. Something unseen controls.
Effect: Swap positions with Cait

Name: The Weightless Choice
Description: Two doors. One opens to you. One to me. Neither opens unless the other is shut.
Effect: One player gets +2 Hope, other loses 1 Sanity (must agree)

Name: The Drowned Choir
Description: Voices rise in harmony, but not with yours. Your name is out of tune.
Effect: -1 Hope, gain item: Choral Thread

Name: The Bone Orchard
Description: The trees here don't grow leaves—they grow ribs.
Effect: Gain item: Rib Key. Use to open special locked encounter

Name: Echoes in Wax
Description: Melted figures whisper your own confessions back to you.
Effect: -1 Sanity, reveal 1 nearby tile

Name: Chamber of Knotted Veins
Description: Pulses throb from the walls. You feel them match your heartbeat.
Effect: Gain item: Vein Map. Lets you move twice next turn.

Name: The Pale Rehearsal
Description: They practiced dying here, over and over again. Now it's your turn.
Effect: Lose 1 Health, gain 1 Hope

Name: Corridor of Apologies
Description: The walls beg forgiveness for something they didn’t do.
Effect: +1 Hope if you give up an item

Name: The Leeching Root
Description: It grows toward warmth. Toward guilt. And now toward you.
Effect: -1 Sanity, +1 Health

Name: The Hollow Feast
Description: A banquet of memory. You’re not hungry. It feeds anyway.
Effect: Lose 1 item, +2 Hope

Name: The Womb of Iron
Description: It doesn't birth things. It absorbs them.
Effect: Lose 1 item permanently, gain 1 random item

Name: The Paper Cathedral
Description: A church made of books and broken promises.
Effect: +1 Sanity if holding Memory Tome

Name: The Gasping Gate
Description: It breathes in regret, exhales denial.
Effect: Lose 1 Hope to reveal the Final Gate’s location

Name: Teeth in the Floor
Description: You stepped too hard. It bites back.
Effect: -2 Health

Name: The Clockmaker’s Gallows
Description: You hear the ticking stop. Time is watching.
Effect: Skip a turn, then gain +1 Sanity

Name: Gallery of Self-Doubt
Description: Every painting is of you, flinching.
Effect: -1 Hope, +1 Sanity if Cait is present

Name: The Mourning Closet
Description: It reeks of old loss and recent breath.
Effect: Gain item: Mourning Veil (+1 Sanity if held)

Name: The Blood-Slick Mirror
Description: Reflections bleed truths you didn’t say.
Effect: -1 Sanity, +1 Hope

Name: The Hollow Host
Description: It welcomes you with arms full of nothing.
Effect: +1 Health, lose 1 Hope

Name: The Smiling Husk
Description: It wears your skin like a promise.
Effect: -1 Sanity, gain item: Husk Mask (disguise tile effects)

Name: The Weeping Ledger
Description: It knows what you owe. And it's still calculating.
Effect: Lose 1 Health, gain 1 Hope, +1 item next encounter

Name: The Glass Colossus
Description: A shattered giant weeps molten glass tears into your hands.
Effect: -1 Health, gain item: Tearshard (use to reveal any tile)

Name: The Skeletal Pianist
Description: It plays without fingers. The song is your pulse.
Effect: +1 Sanity if you skip your next move

Name: Cathedral of Static
Description: A loud silence crackles through ancient tech ruins.
Effect: -1 Sanity, gain item: Signal Crown (resist next encounter effect)

Name: Tower of the Forgotten Signal
Description: A beacon blinks out a message you almost understand.
Effect: Reveal 3 tiles in a line from your current position

Name: The Chain That Whispers
Description: It wraps around you like a question you’re afraid to ask.
Effect: Lose 1 Hope, gain item: Whisper Link (lets you pull Cait one tile)

Name: The Lantern Maw
Description: It lights the way by consuming what you love.
Effect: Lose an item, gain +1 Health and +1 Sanity

Name: Dagger in the Cradle
Description: A lullaby drips from the blade. You know the words.
Effect: -1 Hope, gain item: Singing Blade (+1 attack if combat added later)

Name: The Rustbone Choir
Description: Their harmony fractures bone but heals pride.
Effect: -2 Health, +2 Hope

Name: Archive of Misremembered Promises
Description: You find a vow written in your own handwriting.
Effect: +1 Sanity, -1 Hope

Name: The Salting Tree
Description: Its branches grow from old wounds. They reach for yours.
Effect: -1 Health, gain item: Saltroot Bandage (+2 Health on use)

Name: The Bone Lantern
Description: It lights only things that have died.
Effect: Gain item: Bone Lantern (lets you sense death tiles nearby)

Name: The Stillbirth Clock
Description: Its hands move backwards. One just twitched.
Effect: -1 Hope, skip next Cait turn

Name: The Limbo Hearth
Description: It burns with warmth that doesn’t reach the skin.
Effect: +1 Sanity if below 3 Hope

Name: Altar of Echoed Sins
Description: Your crimes are written here. In someone else’s blood.
Effect: -1 Sanity, +1 Hope if you give up an item

Name: The Salt-Tongued Prophet
Description: They scream truths you’re not ready to hear.
Effect: -1 Sanity, reveal 1 tile, gain item: Saltword Scroll

Name: The Tarnished Halo
Description: Once sacred. Now it just feels heavy.
Effect: Gain item: Halo Fragment (+1 Hope, but lose 1 Health every third turn if held)

Name: The Cradle of Static
Description: It rocks an invisible child. The crying won’t stop.
Effect: -1 Sanity every visit unless holding Eternal Candle

Name: The Maw of Sleep
Description: You feel the yawn crawl up your spine.
Effect: Skip your next action to restore +1 Health and +1 Sanity

Name: The Windowless House
Description: It has walls. No doors. Yet you are inside.
Effect: Roll a d6: (1-3) lose 1 Health, (4-6) gain 1 random item

Name: The Hung Verdict
Description: The sentence was passed. The guilt remains.
Effect: -1 Hope. If Cait is present, both lose 1 Sanity unless holding Veil of Remorse

Name: The Corridor of Crooked Steps
Description: Each step is a question. Each answer twists your ankle.
Effect: -1 Health, +1 Hope

Name: The Screaming Frame
Description: A portrait that only shows you what you were before the guilt.
Effect: -1 Sanity, gain item: Painted Memory

Name: The Casket of Kindness
Description: It holds every favor you never returned.
Effect: +1 Hope, lose 1 item if inventory not empty

Name: The Sleeping Choir
Description: They dream of the day you join them.
Effect: Skip a turn to gain +2 Sanity

Name: Throne of Melted Faces
Description: They weep wax. They smile anyway.
Effect: Gain item: Wax Crown (+1 Hope, -1 Sanity when worn)

Name: The Hungry Cot
Description: The cradle rocks. The teeth beneath it do too.
Effect: -1 Health, +1 Hope if you drop an item

Name: The Vine of Apologies
Description: It wraps tighter with every sorry you didn’t mean.
Effect: -1 Hope, +1 Sanity

Name: The Bleeding Mask
Description: It fits perfectly. Too perfectly.
Effect: -1 Sanity, gain item: Face of Another

Name: The Watcher’s Gallows
Description: Something unseen judges every move you make.
Effect: -1 Hope if Cait is not present

Name: The Garden of Apologies
Description: The flowers wilt when you speak.
Effect: Gain item: Regret Seed (revive one destroyed item)

Name: The Gutless Choir
Description: They sing only from memory. And now they want yours.
Effect: -1 Sanity, reveal a nearby tile

Name: The Lullaby Tomb
Description: It hums a lullaby you recognize but can’t place.
Effect: +1 Hope if you do nothing this turn

Name: The Rotting Marriage
Description: Vows echo through the hollow rings.
Effect: -1 Hope, gain item: Rusted Band

Name: The Freezing Prayer
Description: You mouth words you don’t understand. Your breath crystallizes.
Effect: -1 Health, +1 Sanity

Name: The Nameless Choir
Description: They sing of everyone but you.
Effect: -1 Hope, gain item: Echo Thread

Name: The Shattered Stage
Description: No one claps. You bow anyway.
Effect: Gain item: Splintered Mask, +1 Hope

Name: The Puppeted Pilgrim
Description: It marches forever toward nowhere.
Effect: -1 Sanity unless you mimic Cait’s last move

Name: The Candle-Melt Oracle
Description: Drips fall like fate. Burn or be buried.
Effect: -1 Health, gain item: Oracle Wick (once per game, cancel 1 effect)

Name: The Path of Remembered Crimes
Description: Each step recalls a different mistake.
Effect: -1 Hope every other turn while standing here

Name: The Machine That Regrets
Description: It ticks, whirs, then sighs. You feel it too.
Effect: Choose to reset one revealed tile. Lose 1 Sanity.
